content:
On Feb 4, 2026, Optimism's development focused on enhancing flashblock validation and testing robustness within the `optimism` repository, alongside expanding protocol specifications for L2 contract upgrades in `specs`. Additionally, the Superchain registry was updated with a new address for SaferSafes, and several new pull requests were opened across various repositories, indicating ongoing work on documentation, token updates, and internal tooling.

## 🚨 Needs Attention
- **Pull Requests to Review**:
    - ethereum-optimism/docs: [#1976](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/1976) addresses reth snapshots and is awaiting review.
    - ethereum-optimism/specs: [#889](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/pull/889) proposes adding documentation regarding the Kona build determinism invariant.
    - ethereum-optimism/specs: [#888](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/pull/888) aims to update preimage hints within the specifications.
    - ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io: [#1277](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1277) updates the circulating supply.
    - ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io: [#1276](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1276) adds the SKL Token.
    - ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io: [#1275](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1275) adds the RealGold token.
    - ethereum-optimism/optimism: [#19090](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19090) fixes a reproducibility test for `op-program`.
    - ethereum-optimism/optimism: [#19089](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19089) bumps `git2` from 0.20.2 to 0.20.4 in `/kona`.
    - ethereum-optimism/optimism: [#19088](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19088) enables building contracts in Docker for `op-deployer`.
    - ethereum-optimism/optimism: [#19085](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19085) addresses service shutdown, initialization, and state handling issues.
    - ethereum-optimism/optimism: [#19083](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19083) uses a standard pattern for admin RPC in `op-interop-filter`.
    - ethereum-optimism/optimism: [#19081](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19081) removes `IndexedBlobHash` usage and simplifies blob handling in `kona`.
    - ethereum-optimism/optimism: [#19080](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19080) removes deprecated blob sidecars client and related code from `op-service` and `op-program`.
    - ethereum-optimism/optimism: [#19079](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19079) adds a block-level throttling acceptance test to `op-acceptance-tests`.
    - ethereum-optimism/optimism: [#19078](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19078) verifies chain with kona proofs interop in `op-acceptance`.
- **Urgent Discussions**:
    - ethereum-optimism/optimism: Issue [#19086](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19086) discusses hooking `op-supervisor` to `logsDB` metrics.
    - ethereum-optimism/optimism: Issue [#19087](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19087) proposes defining a test for `op-reth` using the `OP_DEV` network.

## ✅ Completed Work
### Superchain Configuration Updates
- The SaferSafes address was added to the `superchain.toml` files for both Sepolia and Mainnet environments in the `superchain-registry`. ([#1197](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1197))

### Protocol Specification Enhancements
- New documentation has been added to detail L2 contract upgrades, including execution and contract specifics within the protocol specifications in `specs`. ([#884](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/pull/884))

### Core Protocol Enhancements and Validation
- A new validation module has been added for flashblocks to ensure sequence ordering and reorg detection, contributing to the speculative flashblock building design in `optimism`. ([#18993](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18993))

### Improved Testing and CI/CD
- The acceptance tests for stalling chains have been updated to be more robust, addressing previous CI failures and enhancing the overall stability of the testing suite in `optimism`. ([#19062](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19062))
- Docker builds have been removed from the merge queue to streamline the CI process in `optimism`. ([#19082](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19082))

### Internal Tooling and Supernode Refinements
- A unified ID type system was introduced for `op-devstack` to reduce boilerplate code in `optimism`. ([#18872](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18872))
- The `supernode` now handles genesis L2 blocks more efficiently in L1AtSafeHead lookups in `optimism`. ([#19053](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19053))
- The release note generation process has been generalized in `optimism`. ([#19060](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19060))

### System Go and Interop Readiness
- The `sysgo` module now restores Portal ProxyAdmin owners after superroot migration, ensuring correct ownership in `optimism`. ([#19084](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19084))

    - [#889](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/pull/889) docs: add kona build determinism invariant.
    - [#888](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/pull/888) Update preimage hints.
- **ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io**:
    - [#1277](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1277) updates the circulating supply.
    - [#1276](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1276) adds SKL Token.
    - [#1275](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1275) adds RealGold token.
- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - [#19090](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19090) op-program: Fix reproducibility test. The short version should not include the v prefix.
    - [#19089](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19089) dependabot(cargo): bump git2 from 0.20.2 to 0.20.4 in /kona.
    - [#19088](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19088) feat(op-deployer): build contracts in docker.
    - [#19085](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19085) Fix service shutdown, initialization, and state handling issues.
    - [#19083](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19083) op-interop-filter: use standard pattern for admin RPC.
    - [#19081](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19081) kona: Remove IndexedBlobHash usage and simplify blob handling.
    - [#19080](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19080) op-service, op-program: rip out deprecated blob sidecars client and related code.
    - [#19079](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19079) op-acceptance-tests: add block-level throttling acceptance test.
    - [#19078](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19078) op-acceptance: Verify chain with kona proofs interop.

## 🐞 Issue Triage

- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - [#19086](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19086) Metrics and Testing for `op-supervisor` and `op-reth`: Discusses hooking `op-supervisor` to `logsDB` metrics.
    - [#19087](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19087) Metrics and Testing for `op-supervisor` and `op-reth`: Proposes defining a test for `op-reth` using the `OP_DEV` network.

- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - [#18616](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18616) Interop Proofs Acceptance Test Enablement: This issue, concerning the enablement of skipped acceptance tests for interop proofs, was closed after being reopened and reclosed multiple times due to a persistent TODO/skip reference in the codebase.
